tagline: Bhakti jo screen par jeevant lage.
app_concept: Premium devotional live wallpaper application focused on Indian deities, spiritual environments and beautiful animated wallpapers with backend-driven dynamic content and a secure responsive web Admin Panel.

devanagari.usage: For Hindi spiritual quotes and Aaj Ka Darshan headers

grids_and_layouts.mobile_shell: Max-width wrapper simulating an immersive Android device view with device bezels and toggleable responsive web admin view
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: Used for featured daily darshan, live wallpaper categories, and trending devotinal art
grids_and_layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout with overview cards, rich data tables, CRUD modals, and secure JWT verification

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Used for smooth screen switching and staggered card entrance animations

image_urls.description: Adiyogi Shiva statue against dramatic sky
Ganesha statue adorned with garlands on ornate throne
Meditative deity statue during sunset glow

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Meets WCAG AA standards for dark background with gold (#D4AF37) and white text
accessibility.data_testids: Mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive elements, tabs, buttons, and form inputs
